subject: Maths
title: Dividing fractions
subtitle: Fractions — All Operations · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can divide fractions by flipping the second fraction and multiplying.

key_vocab.term: To divide by a fraction, we keep, change, flip
key_vocab.definition: keep the first fraction, change division to multiplication, and flip (find the reciprocal of) the second fraction.
The reciprocal of &frac{a}{b} is &frac{b}{a}. Dividing by a fraction makes the answer bigger.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can divide fractions by flipping the second fraction and multiplying.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content:
To divide by a fraction, we keep, change, flip -- keep the first fraction, change division to multiplication, and flip (find the reciprocal of) the second fraction.
Remember -- The reciprocal of &frac{a}{b} is &frac{b}{a}. Dividing by a fraction makes the answer bigger.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Keep the first fraction, change the operation to multiplication, flip the second fraction.
&frac{a}{b} ÷ &frac{c}{d} = &frac{a}{b} × &frac{d}{c}
Keep, Change, Flip

Key examples:
  ✓ &frac{2}{3} ÷ &frac{1}{4} = &frac{8}{3}  (flip and multiply)
  ✓ &frac{3}{5} ÷ &frac{2}{7} = &frac{21}{10}  (keep, change, flip)
  ✓ &frac{1}{2} ÷ 3 = &frac{1}{6}  (3 = &frac{3}{1}, flip to &frac{1}{3})
  ✗ &frac{2}{3} ÷ &frac{1}{4} = &frac{2}{12}  (multiplied without flipping)
  ✗ &frac{3}{5} ÷ &frac{2}{7} = &frac{6}{35}  (did not flip second fraction)

sections.title: Worked Example
Dividing by whole numbers
sections.content:
Divide each fraction by the whole number.

(a) &frac{3}{4} ÷ 3
(b) &frac{5}{6} ÷ 5
(c) &frac{2}{3} ÷ 4
(d) &frac{7}{8} ÷ 7
